propositions: Test harness project keys drawn from _random_project_key can end with any letter A-Z; when the drawn key ends in 'Z', the derivation that replaces the last character with 'Z' produces a byte-identical collision with the source key.
The test fails roughly 1 in 26 runs due to uniform random distribution of final letters; the collision is not a product regression but a test construction defect.
The setup assertion `new_project_key != jira_dc_project` correctly catches the collision and must be retained as a safety guard.
Derivation logic must guarantee no collision for any key the harness can generate, proven by a unit test covering edge cases including keys ending in the replacement character.
